subject: reasoning
question:
In the following triads, each group of letters is related to the subsequent one following a certain logic. Select from the given options, the one that follows the same logic.

SAND - DSNA - SDAN

GUNT - TGNU - GTUN
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/15d4e688c8bdc2766cb74c67a7c0d12a85a1e60bc448f376b860b7949a5ae586.png] 

The logic followed here is:

SAND - DSNA - SDAN

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/8f220031a882cdd500f49a36606d2b7916ed7fb97dd467d07f19833d4252c385.png] 

And,

GUNT - TGNU - GTUN

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/a5f3960b9d471eeb9af0f9dc5900d370cb7f7bcf7dab35fc42fe0e0413f3ffdf.png] 

Similarly,

Option 4) JUNK - KJNU - JKUN

​ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/5f9fee74ade16fea58694d4ed0c7e22d991ea2f070a0035125ff80785153c55a.png] ​

Hence, "Option 4" is the correct answer.
